Article.ArticleTitle: MINT: A toolbox for the analysis of multivariate neural information coding and transmission.

Abstract.AbstractText: MINT combines multivariate information methods with robust estimation tools and is freely available at https://github.com/panzerilab/MINT.

Article.ArticleTitle: Multimodal cue integration and learning in a neural representation of head direction.

Abstract.AbstractText: The Drosophila head direction system integrates spatial cues with varying informativeness using population calcium imaging and multimodal virtual reality.
